html:
Settlement proof

Use the same operating facts before financial closeout.

BOF connects delivered work, operating exceptions, proof packet, approved adjustments, settlement state, responsible owners, and the next action shared by operations and finance.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Operating record, delivery evidence, receipts, approved rate or pay inputs, exceptions, adjustment support, and accountable owners.

Review path

Operations and finance review the same source facts, missing support, dispute state, approval context, and unresolved responsibility.

Decision-ready output

A shared closeout record with proof, approved outcome supplied by the fleet, open exceptions, owners, and next action.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

Financial closeout does not proceed on a different version of the facts than the operating team.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A shared closeout record with proof, approved outcome supplied by the fleet, open exceptions, owners, and next action. Financial closeout does not proceed on a different version of the facts than the operating team.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF supports administrative alignment and does not provide accounting, tax, payroll, lending, collection, or fiduciary services.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
